name: TC-173: an invalid gift card code is rejected
description: Applying a code that doesn't exist shows an error and no discount is applied.
descriptionHtml: Applying a code that doesn't exist shows an error and no discount is applied.

testStage.description: Applying a code that doesn't exist shows an error and no discount is applied.

steps.name: Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Fill "NOPE1790918559694" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').locator('p.text-red-500')
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText(/Gift card applied: -\$\d/)

labels.name: titlePath
labels.value: > customer > customer/02-checkout.spec.ts > Customer — Checkout gift card
